name: minirag-mcp
description: Search a folder of your own documents from Claude. Indexing and search run on your computer.
long_description:
Point minirag at a folder of documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, EPUB, Markdown, plain text, meeting transcripts) and Claude can search it: semantic similarity plus a keyword boost for exact terms, names and codes, with every answer traceable to the file it came from.

Nothing is uploaded. Documents are converted and indexed on this computer, and the index is stored next to them in a hidden `.minirag` folder. Installing downloads the extension's Python dependencies; after that, the only network traffic is the one-time download of the embedding model (about 220 MB, on the first sync) and a web page you explicitly ask it to fetch.

**First use:** ask Claude to "sync minirag", wait for the sync to finish, then ask questions about your documents.

documents_folder.title: Documents folder
documents_folder.description: The folder to make searchable. Everything inside it, including subfolders, can be indexed; nothing outside it can be read.

tools.name: sync_start

tools.name: query_documents

tools.name: find_mentions
tools.description: List every document that mentions a word or phrase

tools.name: read_chunk_neighbors
tools.description: Read the passages around a search hit

tools.name: list_files
